reading.zh: 四个注入器按触发时机分三档：目标与计划是节奏驱动的常驻提醒，权限模式与 Swarm 只在状态跃迁时打一次标记，中断提醒是上一回合留下的回声。
reading.en: Four injectors in three cadence classes: goal and plan are rhythm-driven standing reminders, permission-mode and swarm fire a one-shot marker only on a state transition, and the interruption reminder is the echo left by the previous turn.
